trial_court: TR.C.M.P.NO.213 of 2022, XVI Addl. District and Sessions Judge cum III Addl. Family Court, Ranga Reddy District at Malkajgiri
case_name: Thandra Ionnapalli Supraja Tejaswi vs J.N.Venkatesh
facts_of_case: Petitioner's marriage with respondent was performed on 26-05-2019. Petitioner joined the respondent but her marital life was cordial for only two months. Respondent started harassing her for additional dowry and she was subjected to physical and mental harassment.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking transfer to show sufficient reasons for the same.
legal_principles.held: It is not appropriate to weigh the alleged whatsapp chatting or other conversations in the present transfer petition.

legal_principles.principle: The court will not weigh the merits of a case while considering a transfer petition.
legal_principles.held: It is not appropriate to weigh the alleged whatsapp chatting or other conversations in the present transfer petition.

outcome.final_order: Petitioner's prayer to transfer F.C.O.P.No.317 of 2020 to the Court of Senior Civil Judge, Peddapalli or Family Court, Karimnagar was allowed.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for transfer of case
